「
くそ、何が起きてる……！」
庭で何か起きている事は明白だった。
吐き気がする陰湿な魔力が、触れられるほどに渦を巻いて外に溢れ出しているのだ。
そんなもの、魔術師でなくとも異常を感じ取れる。

pages.en:
“—Damn it. What's happening…!?”

Something was plainly happening out there—in the garden.

Malignant magical energy churns so thickly I could almost touch it, spilling outward with a malice that turns my stomach.

Even someone who knew nothing of magecraft would feel that something was wrong.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Damn, what’s going on…!?”
It’s obvious that something’s going on in the yard.
A damp magical energy that makes me want to vomit is swirling so much that I can almost touch it.
I would feel the abnormality even if I weren’t a magus.

「な
」
覚悟していたとは言え、一瞬、その光景に目眩がした。
コールタールのような影に覆われた遠坂。
庭の端に佇むイリヤと、イリヤの前に立つ黒いセイバー。
そして、中庭の真ん中で、遠坂に掌を突き出している桜の姿

pages.en:
“Wh—”

Prepared though I am, the sight leaves me dizzy for an instant.

Tohsaka, smothered in a shadow like coal tar.

Illya standing at the edge of the garden, with the black Saber before her.

And Sakura in the center of the courtyard, one palm extended toward Tohsaka—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Wha
”
I was prepared for it, but I get dizzy the instant I see it.
Tohsaka is covered by a shadow like coal tar.
Illya is standing at the side of the yard, and Black Saber is standing in front of her.
And in the middle of the yard is Sakura, pointing her hand at Tohsaka

pages.ja:
「桜
！！！！」

pages.en:
“Sakura————!”

I charge into the courtyard.

—Every one of them demands my attention, but Tohsaka is in the greatest danger now.

Her face is deathly pale beneath the coal-black mire. She looks as though even a second's delay in treating her could be dangerous.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Sakura
!!!!”
I jump into the yard.
I have to help them both, but Tohsaka is in the most danger right now.
Covered in coal tar, Tohsaka looks pale, and it looks like her life is in danger.

」

She does not answer when I lift her into my arms.

“Damn it. Hold on. I'll get this stuff off you…!”

が、泥は液体のクセに、弾力のあるゴムそのものだった。
掴んでも掴めないし、剥がしてもすぐさま元に戻ってしまう……！

pages.en:
I try to peel the mud away from Tohsaka.

Yet liquid though it is, it has all the spring and resilience of solid rubber.

My fingers cannot take hold of it, and whatever I do manage to tear away flows back into place at once…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
I tear away the mud that’s covering her.
The mud is gelatinous, but it’s just like rubber.
I can’t grab it, and even if I pull it off of her body, it just bounces back onto her.

pages.ja:
「っ……！ なんだこれ、遠坂には触れるのに、どうして……！」
なにをやっても泥は剥がれない。
混乱して、錯乱しそうな頭で遠坂から泥を引き剥がす。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“—! What is this? I can touch Tohsaka through it, so why can't I…!?”

Nothing I do removes the mud.

Confused, my thoughts teetering on the edge of frenzy, I keep trying to rip it from her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……! What is this!? I can touch her, so why…!?”
I can’t get the mud off, no matter what.
I panic and frantically try to free her.

Then—

“—It's no use, Shirou. Only I can dispel my shadow. With skill on your level, you'll only be absorbed yourself.”

Sakura speaks in a voice I have never heard from her before, utterly cold.

A spike of absolute cold, as though a knife had split me from the base of my skull to my tailbone—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
!”

No, this isn’t just a chill.
It’s an intensely cold thorn, as if a knife were slashed from my brain down to my waist.

」

pages.en:
“More importantly, Shirou. Why are you protecting Rin?”

“————”

For an instant, the world before me turns white.

A shadow rises behind Sakura.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Senpai. Why are you protecting Nee-san?”

”

“Ah—”

The chill spreads from my back until terror has frozen my entire body.

That is Sakura.

I could endure being told that the “black shadow” was Sakura.

But now I see it with my own eyes, and I understand.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ah
”
The chill runs throughout my body, paralyzing me with fear.
That’s Sakura.
Even when I heard that the shadow is Sakura, I could bear it.
But now that I’ve seen it, I know.

…My left arm, dissolving helplessly at the merest touch.

The thing that roamed the city killing people without emotion, like a machine carrying out its work—that had been Sakura.

machine
is Sakura.

喉が干からびる。
眼球は痙攣し、
空間が捩じれたように視界が歪む。
全身の細胞が警告を発し、必死に、怖れで凍りついた体を解凍しようと努力する。

“Saku…ra…”

My throat dries to dust.

My eyes spasm.

My vision warps as though space itself has twisted.

Every cell in my body cries out in warning, struggling desperately to thaw the flesh terror has frozen.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Sa… kura.”
My throat goes dry.
My eyeballs convulse.
My vision wavers as if space itself is twisted.
Every cell in me screams a warning, trying to defrost my frozen body.

pages.ja:
だが溶けない。

桜は本気で

But it will not thaw.

Sakura's presence. Something no longer human. Something else, something that is not Sakura.

It is not the immensity of her magical energy overwhelming me.

Only one thing has frozen my body.

Sakura is directing genuine murderous intent at me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But it doesn’t melt.
Sakura’s presence isn’t human, but something different.
It’s not her vast magical energy that got to me.
There’s only one reason why my body’s frozen.
Sakura is being hostile towards me.

pages.mirrorMoon:

pages.ja:

違う、と。
アレは桜ではないと。
思ってはいけない事が、脳裏を埋め尽くした。

—My vision distorts.

At these words from a Sakura I do not know, pieces of my mind begin to crumble.

No.

The thought I must never allow fills my mind.

“Shirou, being with me hurts, doesn't it?

“…This is my final warning. Whatever form it takes, Sakura will obtain the Holy Grail. That is the only means by which she can be set free.

“Even if her death is the result, Sakura Matou will thereby be saved.”

“…This is your final warning. Sakura will obtain the Holy Grail one way or another. That is the only way for her to be released.
Even if the result is her death, Matou Sakura will be saved.”

だが、それでも追ってくるというのなら
その時こそ、その首を叩き落とす」

pages.en:
“If you wish to save Sakura, withdraw.

“But if you pursue her despite this warning—then I shall strike off your head.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“If you wish to save her, then withdraw.
Should you follow us in spite of that
I will take your head.”

pages.ja:
……黒いセイバーの姿が消える。
桜とイリヤの姿もない。
二人は桜の影に沈むように、俺の視界から消え去っていた。

pages.en:
…The black Saber vanishes.

Sakura and Illya are gone as well.

As though sinking into Sakura's shadow, the two disappear from my sight.

…Black Saber disappears.
Sakura and Illya are gone.
They’ve vanished, as if they’ve faded into the shadow.

“D—”

The will that kept my body moving gives out.

My arms and legs fall to the ground like those of a puppet whose strings have been cut.

“—amn.”

pages.ja:
……意識が続かない。
暗くなっていく視界のなか。
影に呑まれていく桜の姿が、俺を弾劾するように、目蓋に焼き付いて離れなかった。

影に呑まれていく桜の姿が、俺を弾劾するように、目蓋に焼き付いて離れなかった。
pages.en:
…I cannot hold on to consciousness.

As my vision darkens, the image of Sakura being swallowed by shadow brands itself behind my eyelids and will not leave, accusing me without end.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…I can’t stay conscious.
As my vision fades…
The image of Sakura drowning in the shadow sticks in my mind, as if to impeach me.
